newsitem.title: GERMANY: MG says U.S. unit represents 3 pct of sales.
newsitem.headline: MG says U.S. unit represents 3 pct of sales.

text.p: Metallgesellschaft AG, the German engineering and trading group, said on Monday that its U.S. unit MG Corp represents only about three percent of the group's overall revenues of 15.8 billion marks.

MG chief executive Kajo Neukirchen said the U.S. unit, where MG suffered nearly-crippling losses in energy futures contracts in the early 1990s, had fully unwound all of the contracts at the end of 1995.
All of the losses from the speculative oil trading were placed in MG Corp's U.S. accounts, where the unrealised profit had to be written down.
